out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS texted CFM copy of the employee health policy to review information with food employee, sign the document, and maintain on file for future reference.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the back of the main kitchen is blocked by multiple bulk containers of icing buckets, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM removed bulk icing buckets to allow for easy access to back hand sink.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials (two chemical spray bottles) are not properly labeled with a common name on shelf near 3 vat.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CFM labeled chemical spray bottles with common name.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Grease Trap, Location for Easy Access
violations.observation: The grease trap has been installed in a manner preventing easy access for cleaning of the grease trap. EHS observed multiple chemical cleaning bottles stored on top of the greasetrap at the 3 vat sink
violations.corrective_action: If used, a grease trap shall be located to be easily accessible for cleaning. CDI: CFM relocated chemicals bottles in area away from greasetrap allowing for easy access.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: The PIC was unable to provide the Employee Health policy.
violations.corrective_action: EHS provided a copy of the Employee Health policy to the PIC and reviewed the documents at the time of the inspection for guidance and compliance.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided a copy of the vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures during the inspection for guidance and compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located in the kitchen is blocked by multiple stacked large buckets of cream and filling , preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC moved the buckets so that the hand sink was more accessible for hand washing.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: Galanz under counter cooler
violations.corrective_action: The PIC placed a thermometer inside of the unit for monitoring ambient temperatures. TEXAS DONUTS (Inspection Date: 02/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the hand sink in the kitchen area are leaking and flooding the floor, when turned on.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC was able to tighten the plumbing connections and the water stopped flowing onto the floor.
